afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KGJT 051741 AFDGJT Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Grand Junction CO 1141 AM MDT Mon Oct 5 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - Mostly dry conditions continue through much of the week. An isolated shower or storm is possible over the San Juans and central mountains each afternoon. - Temperatures will run 5 to 15 degrees above more seasonal norms. - A stronger storm system may pass

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Above normal temperatures and generally dry weather will continue to be the daily forecast through at least Friday. Lingering moisture will support isolated showers and thunderstorms over the higher terrain, particularly the San Juans, each afternoon. alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148517
alerts.description: Between Exit 129: Bair Ranch (6 miles west of the Dotsero area) and Exit 125: Hanging Lake (5 miles east of the No Name area) from Mile Point 126 to Mile Point 125. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting October 6, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 6, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 6, 7:00AM - October 6, 7:00PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
